jobs.title: Head of Information Technology
jobs.description:
For over 130 years, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) Group’s innovative and integrated solutions have demonstrated our commitment to creating a positive social impact around the globe. Our range of products and services are tailored to meet our customers’ evolving needs across the commercial aviation, energy, transportation and infrastructure, machinery, defense and space systems sectors.

Mitsubishi Heavy Industries America, Inc. (MHIA), headquartered in Houston, Texas, serves as MHI’s North American headquarters. Since 1979, MHIA has supported customers in various sectors, including energy, industrial machinery, data centers, engineering, transportation, aviation, and automotive.

SCOPE:

The Head of Information Technologies serves as a strategic partner to senior leadership, driving the alignment of technology investments with business priorities while leading a high-performing IT organization.

This role is responsible for providing strategic, operational, and tactical leadership to a team of Information Technology & Shared Services professionals supporting MHIA and its affiliates.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Provide input to the strategic direction of IT, directly influencing the business direction in new and existing products and systems as well as upcoming integration efforts with new acquisitions
Participate in the development of the strategic information technology plan, processes and solutions.
Understand the technology risks and information security challenges in the current and future state; contributes to the design and approval of an overall information security strategy.
Promote compliance with MHI Group rules regarding governance, cybersecurity, and information management.
Develop and oversee deployment and adherence to approved IT policies and procedures and monitor industry best practices to maintain and drive IT efficiencies in support of MHIA’s goals.
Build strong relationships with key internal and significant external partners and coordinate and drive business relationships.
Develop a strong working knowledge of clients’ and users’ businesses.
Serve as a strategic business partner to senior leadership, understanding business strategies and goals, and how they are accomplished through effective people strategies and programs.
Build and foster a customer-centric and product-focused mindset across the organization, actively partnering with the business leaders to identify efficiencies.
Lead, expand, and mentor the IT team by setting the strategy and prioritizing Objectives and KPIs. Hiring, training, and developing a world-class team.
Assess the IT team's capacity to meet customer demands and supplement internal capabilities by leveraging contractors, managed services, BPO (Business Process Outsourcing), and other third-party resources.
Review and modify IT team roles and organizational structure as needed to meet customer needs.
Prepare and submit an annual operational budget for each area of responsibility, manage within this budget, and report accurately on progress and challenges.
Report to MHI's DI Headquarters on IT performance, risks, compliance, and strategic initiatives.
Drive global IT strategy within the region, add region-specific initiatives, and develop strong alignment with the global IT functions - the regional IT road map, which is then executed in alignment with MHI Global Information Technologies’ global Support initiatives and programs.
Evaluate external advancements in the IT industry to improve customer and user satisfaction, reduce operating expenses, and maximize revenues.
Other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Education Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience: Minimum of fifteen (15) years of relevant work experience, and a minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in an IT Leadership Role
Ability to manage and influence cross-business and global teams
Ability to understand issues at both strategic and operational levels
Experience building a high-achieving, cross-functional team; can impart business acumen to IT teams

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Preferred: Experience working at a Japanese multinational company

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Travel: Up to 40%
Standard Monday – Friday work week; weekend/late night work, occasionally
Lifting/physical requirements: Regularly required to sit for long periods, stand, walk, talk and/or hear. Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
Full-time work location in Houston HQ office

Why Should You Apply?

Medical, Dental, Vision, and Behavioral Health Benefits
Competitive 401(k) Matching Program
Company-Paid Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Coverage
Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and 15 Paid Holidays
Learning and Development Opportunities, Including Tuition Reimbursement
Opportunities to Support Quality, Innovative Solutions That Contribute to a Net Zero Future

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Location: Greater Washington, DC Area (5 days on site)

Overview

An established software company experiencing significant growth is seeking a technology executive to lead the evolution of its engineering organization, software platforms, and technical strategy. This individual will serve as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with executives across the business to ensure technology investments, product development efforts, and operational priorities support long-term company objectives.
This position requires a unique blend of technical depth, organizational leadership, and executional focus. The successful candidate will be comfortable influencing strategic decisions while remaining engaged in architecture, engineering processes, and complex technical initiatives.

What You'll Do

Establish the long-term technology direction for the organization and guide technology-related business decisions.
Lead and develop engineering teams responsible for building, enhancing, and maintaining software products.
Champion best practices in software development, testing, reliability, security, and operational performance.
Partner with stakeholders across the company to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Evaluate current systems and processes, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, performance, and maintainability.
Provide leadership on platform modernization, cloud strategy, infrastructure planning, and data management initiatives.
Create an environment that encourages innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Oversee technology resource planning, vendor selection, and engineering investment decisions.
Support the growth of the organization by establishing scalable team structures, career development frameworks, and delivery processes.
Contribute to important architecture reviews and technical discussions while guiding engineering teams through complex challenges.

Required Background

Extensive experience leading software engineering organizations in a senior technology leadership capacity.
Demonstrated success delivering and scaling commercial software products.
Strong understanding of modern application architecture, cloud technologies, and software engineering methodologies.
Experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams.
Ability to balance near-term business objectives with long-term platform sustainability.
Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Track record of improving engineering effectiveness through process, tooling, and organizational development.

Technical Environment

While technology experience may vary, ideal candidates will have familiarity with several of the following:
Experience with one or more modern backend development frameworks
SQL and relational database technologies
Cloud-native infrastructure and services
Source control and collaborative development workflows
Modern DevOps and deployment practices
Enterprise-scale web applications
Workflow automation and orchestration technologies
Data-intensive software environments

Ideal Leadership Profile

The organization is interested in leaders who remain closely connected to the work being delivered by their teams. Successful candidates often come from engineering leadership roles where they have combined people management, technical strategy, and hands-on problem solving.
Ideal qualities include:
Growth mindset and entrepreneurial thinking
Ability to lead through influence and collaboration
Comfort operating in evolving, fast-moving environments
Strong technical judgment and decision-making ability
Passion for developing engineering talent and culture
Willingness to engage directly with technical challenges when needed

Dexian stands at the forefront of Talent + Technology solutions with a presence spanning more than 70 locations worldwide and a team exceeding 10,000 professionals. As one of the largest technology and professional staffing companies and one of the largest minority-owned staffing companies in the United States, Dexian combines over 30 years of industry expertise with cutting-edge technologies to deliver comprehensive global services and support.  

Dexian connects the right talent and the right technology with the right organizations to deliver trajectory-changing results that help everyone achieve their ambitions and goals. To learn more, please visit https://dexian.com/.

jobs.description:
Important Note:

The working location for this role is Washington, DC or Reston, VA
, with a hybrid schedule
requiring 3 days onsite each week
.
You will also be eligible for a 35% annual long-term incentive cash bonus
, in addition to the base salary and standard benefits.
Candidates from other states are also welcome to apply. Relocation assistance is not provided; however, relocation expenses may be negotiable as part of the overall annual salary package.

Job Description:

In this compelling leadership position, you will lead efforts examining and analyzing every aspect of Company's IT environment.
Focused on the cutting-edge cloud services Client uses, our audits cover a broad range of exciting technologies, providing a challenging environment with tremendous opportunities for personal growth.
Within IT Audit, the infrastructure team focuses on evaluating Company’s complex environment of IT processes, systems, and services.
We conduct audits focused on highly visible topics, such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), cyber security, IT Governance, resiliency, and the management of the various operating systems and platforms used by Company.
In this position, you will take ownership over audits and reviews, setting direction and being hands-on throughout planning, executing, and reporting.
You will also play a pivotal role in coaching and mentoring other team members.

Responsibilities:

Lead complex IT audits across Cybersecurity, AI, Cloud Infrastructure, and Resiliency.
Identify and assess IT risks and adjust audit plans based on emerging risks.
Participate in annual planning and develop risk-based IT audit plans.
Manage audit projects, provide direction, review work, and coach IT audit staff.
Perform hands-on testing of complex technical environments and high-risk areas.
Develop insights and points of view on AI, Cybersecurity, Cloud, and Resiliency risks.
Build relationships with business partners and provide technical audit guidance.
Use data analytics, automation, and AI to improve audit testing and efficiency.

Requirements:

8+ years of experience in IT Audit, IT Risk Management, or Information Security; 10+ years preferred.
Expert knowledge of Cybersecurity, AI, or Cloud Infrastructure, including AWS.
Strong project management, critical thinking, communication, and coaching skills.
Experience with data analytics and visualization using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, or Seaborn.
Programming/data analytics experience with Python, SciPy, NumPy, and/or PySpark.
Experience using AI in audit execution and understanding AI-related risks and agentic AI architectures.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
Preferred certifications: CISA, CISSP, CEH, CRISC, or CISM.

An established software company experiencing significant growth is seeking a technology executive to lead the evolution of its engineering organization, software platforms, and technical strategy. This individual will serve as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with executives across the business to ensure technology investments, product development efforts, and operational priorities support long-term company objectives.
This position requires a unique blend of technical depth, organizational leadership, and executional focus. The successful candidate will be comfortable influencing strategic decisions while remaining engaged in architecture, engineering processes, and complex technical initiatives.

What You'll Do

Establish the long-term technology direction for the organization and guide technology-related business decisions.
Lead and develop engineering teams responsible for building, enhancing, and maintaining software products.
Champion best practices in software development, testing, reliability, security, and operational performance.

Evaluate current systems and processes, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, performance, and maintainability.
Provide leadership on platform modernization, cloud strategy, infrastructure planning, and data management initiatives.
Create an environment that encourages innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Oversee technology resource planning, vendor selection, and engineering investment decisions.

Contribute to important architecture reviews and technical discussions while guiding engineering teams through complex challenges.

Required Background

Extensive experience leading software engineering organizations in a senior technology leadership capacity.
Demonstrated success delivering and scaling commercial software products.
Strong understanding of modern application architecture, cloud technologies, and software engineering methodologies.
Experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams.

Track record of improving engineering effectiveness through process, tooling, and organizational development.

Experience with one or more modern backend development frameworks

Cloud-native infrastructure and services
Source control and collaborative development workflows
Modern DevOps and deployment practices
Enterprise-scale web applications
Workflow automation and orchestration technologies
Data-intensive software environments

Ideal qualities include:
Growth mindset and entrepreneurial thinking

Job Description:

In this compelling leadership position, you will lead efforts examining and analyzing every aspect of Company's IT environment.
Focused on the cutting-edge cloud services Client uses, our audits cover a broad range of exciting technologies, providing a challenging environment with tremendous opportunities for personal growth.
Within IT Audit, the infrastructure team focuses on evaluating Company’s complex environment of IT processes, systems, and services.
We conduct audits focused on highly visible topics, such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), cyber security, IT Governance, resiliency, and the management of the various operating systems and platforms used by Company.
In this position, you will take ownership over audits and reviews, setting direction and being hands-on throughout planning, executing, and reporting.
You will also play a pivotal role in coaching and mentoring other team members.

Responsibilities:

Lead complex IT audits across Cybersecurity, AI, Cloud Infrastructure, and Resiliency.
Identify and assess IT risks and adjust audit plans based on emerging risks.
Participate in annual planning and develop risk-based IT audit plans.
Manage audit projects, provide direction, review work, and coach IT audit staff.
Perform hands-on testing of complex technical environments and high-risk areas.
Develop insights and points of view on AI, Cybersecurity, Cloud, and Resiliency risks.
Build relationships with business partners and provide technical audit guidance.

Strong project management, critical thinking, communication, and coaching skills.
Experience with data analytics and visualization using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, or Seaborn.
